papers.title: Single-cell epigenomics of colorectal cancer.
papers.authors: Kang, Dain; Lee, Jun Ho; Jung, Inkyung
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦结直肠癌单细胞表观基因组学，虽涉及染色质可及性和顺式调控元件，但以肿瘤异质性和临床转化为主，缺乏三维基因组/染色质空间架构建模及AI或分子模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) exhibits remarkable phenotypic heterogeneity that cannot be fully explained by genetic alterations alone. Advances in single-nucleus assay for transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing have revealed chromatin accessibility as a central regulatory layer shaping tumor identity, cellular plasticity and therapeutic response. In this Review, we synthesize recent single-cell epigenomic studies to outline an emerging regulatory principle for CRC. From an epigenetic perspective, CRC can be conceptualized as two distinct epigenomic states, intrinsic consensus molecular subtype (iCMS)2 and iCMS3, defined by divergent cis-regulatory element activities across distal enhancer and promoter landscapes. Tumor progression is accompanied by stepwise regulatory rewiring, encompassing erosion of differentiation programs in adenomas, regulatory bifurcation during malignant transformation, oncofetal reprogramming associated with therapy resistance and organotropic adaptation during metastasis. We further discuss how stromal and immune compartments undergo dynamic epigenomic remodeling, converging toward a concept of iCMS-defined epigenomic ecosystems, and how genomic alterations engage in bidirectional crosstalk with chromatin states to generate intratumoral heterogeneity. Finally, we highlight translational applications including epigenetic-immune combination therapies, liquid biopsy-based monitoring, spatial epigenomics and artificial intelligence-driven modeling.
papers.abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）表现出显著的表型异质性，仅靠遗传改变无法完全解释。单核转座酶可及染色质测序（single-nucleus assay for transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing）的进展揭示了染色质可及性作为塑造肿瘤身份、细胞可塑性和治疗反应的核心调控层。在本综述中，我们综合了近期单细胞表观基因组研究，以勾勒CRC的新兴调控原则。从表观遗传学视角来看，CRC可被概念化为两种不同的表观基因组状态，即内在共有分子亚型（iCMS）2和iCMS3，这些状态由远端增强子和启动子景观中不同的顺式调控元件活性所定义。肿瘤进展伴随逐步的调控重连，包括腺瘤中分化程序的侵蚀、恶性转化过程中的调控分叉、与治疗耐药相关的肿瘤胎儿重编程以及转移过程中的器官趋向性适应。我们进一步讨论了基质和免疫区室如何经历动态表观基因组重塑，汇聚于iCMS定义的表观基因组生态系统概念，以及基因组改变如何与染色质状态进行双向串扰以产生瘤内异质性。最后，我们强调了转化应用，包括表观遗传-免疫联合疗法、基于液体活检的监测、空间表观基因组学和人工智能驱动的建模。

papers.title: Canalization masks high levels of cryptic epigenetic and transcriptional plasticity in butterflies
papers.authors: Brady NK; van der Burg KRL; Reed RD
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究蝴蝶翅膀发育中染色质可及性与转录可塑性的群体差异，虽涉及染色质可及性和机器学习分析，但对象非三维基因组/染色质组织，且无空间架构建模或AI/分子模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
papers.abstract: Phenotypic plasticity is a common adaptation to heterogeneous environments. While it is well documented that trait plasticity can rapidly evolve, little is known about the developmental mechanisms that underlie variation in plasticity. Here, we compare diverged populations of the common buckeye butterfly (Junonia coenia): one population with canalized wing patterns that are insensitive to environmental conditions and another population that has distinctive seasonal color patterns. In common garden trials we were surprised to find dramatically elevated levels of transcriptional and chromatin accessibility plasticity during wing development of the canalized population compared to the seasonally plastic population. Further, using machine learning analysis of accessible chromatin sequences, we observed a broad heterochronic shift in motifs enriched in plastic putative regulatory elements to earlier stages of development in the canalized population, which we speculate may cause phenotype-related gene expression to move outside a wing color critical period. Together, our data lead us to propose a model where cryptic genetic processes are masked by a shift in chromatin remodeling, which in turn could produce a capacitor-like effect to maintain developmental genetic variation in the canalized population.
papers.abstract_zh: 表型可塑性是对异质环境的一种常见适应。虽然已有充分记录表明性状可塑性可以快速演化，但关于支撑可塑性变异的发育机制知之甚少。在此，我们比较了普通眼蝶（Junonia coenia）的分化种群：一个种群的翅斑模式被渠化，对环境条件不敏感，而另一个种群则具有独特的季节性色彩模式。在共同园实验中，我们惊讶地发现，与季节性可塑性种群相比，渠化种群在翅发育过程中转录和染色质可及性可塑性水平显著升高。进一步，利用可及染色质序列的机器学习分析，我们观察到在渠化种群中，可塑性推定调控元件中富集的基序出现广泛的异时性转变，向发育更早阶段移动，我们推测这可能使表型相关基因表达移出翅色关键期。综合来看，我们的数据促使我们提出一个模型，其中隐性遗传过程被染色质重塑的转变所掩盖，这反过来可能产生类似电容器效应，以维持渠化种群中的发育遗传变异。

papers.title: Entropy-driven machine learning for deciphering mRNA rearrangement by splicing in complex microorganisms.
papers.authors: Mancini, Alessio; Merelli, Emanuela; Piangerelli, Marco; Pucciarelli, Sandra; Vito, Leonardo
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用可解释机器学习预测四膜虫内含子保留，聚焦剪接调控而非染色质三维组织，且无AI/分子模拟的空间架构建模，与本课题关联微弱。
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Alternative splicing allows a single gene to produce multiple messenger RNA (mRNA) variants by differential RNA processing, resulting in the translation of distinct protein isoforms. Intron retention (IR) is a specific type of alternative splicing in which introns remain unspliced in the mature mRNA. The exact regulatory code behind intron splicing remains not fully deciphered, and unraveling these mechanisms is critical to uncovering the foundations of genetic disorders: a substantial fraction of disease-causing mutations disrupt intron splicing. METHODS: We applied explainable machine learning (xML) models to intronic sequences from four species of the ciliate genus Tetrahymena (T. thermophila, T. malaccensis, T. borealis and T. elliotti), which allow the intron retention process to be analysed without tissue-specific confounders. Retained introns (RIs) and constitutively spliced introns (CSIs) were extracted through an automated Galaxy pipeline and described by several features of the intronic sequences, including the absence of repetitive nucleotide motifs - quantified as entropy - the GC content, the complexity of the secondary structures as estimated by the Lempel-Ziv (LZ) measure, and the effective distance between the branch point and the 3' splice site. Four classifiers were compared by 10-fold cross-validation within the training set and evaluated on an independent test set. RESULTS: Across 289.6 k analysed introns, the C5.0 decision tree gave the best and most consistent performance, ranking first in three of the four species (accuracy 0.948-0.984). The key distinguishing features of retained introns were a higher entropy (Shannon entropy above 1.67, versus below 1.53 for constitutively spliced introns, against a theoretical maximum of 2) and more complex secondary structures near the 3' splice sites, together with a greater effective branch-point-to-3'-splice-site distance and a relative enrichment of the GC dinucleotide. DISCUSSION: These features converge on weaker, less accessible splicing signals, which may impair splice-site recognition and bias the outcome towards retention. Our work identifies key sequence-level features predictive of intron retention in Tetrahymena and could provide a generalizable, explainable ML framework for investigating splicing regulation in other eukaryotes.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言：可变剪接（alternative splicing）使得单个基因通过差异RNA加工产生多种信使RNA（mRNA）变体，从而翻译出不同的蛋白质亚型。内含子保留（intron retention, IR）是可变剪接的一种特定类型，其中内含子在成熟mRNA中未被剪接。内含子剪接背后的精确调控代码尚未完全破译，揭示这些机制对于发现遗传疾病的基础至关重要：相当一部分致病突变会破坏内含子剪接。方法：我们将可解释机器学习（explainable machine learning, xML）模型应用于来自纤毛虫属四膜虫（Tetrahymena）四个物种（T. thermophila、T. malaccensis、T. borealis和T. elliotti）的内含子序列，这些序列允许在没有组织特异性混杂因素的情况下分析内含子保留过程。通过自动化Galaxy流程提取保留内含子（retained introns, RIs）和组成型剪接内含子（constitutively spliced introns, CSIs），并用内含子序列的多个特征进行描述，包括重复核苷酸基序的缺失（以熵量化）、GC含量、通过Lempel-Ziv（LZ）度量估计的二级结构复杂性，以及分支点与3'剪接位点之间的有效距离。在训练集内通过10折交叉验证比较了四个分类器，并在独立测试集上进行了评估。结果：在分析的289.6千个内含子中，C5.0决策树表现最佳且最一致，在四个物种中的三个中排名第一（准确率0.948-0.984）。保留内含子的关键区分特征包括更高的熵（Shannon熵高于1.67，而组成型剪接内含子低于1.53，理论最大值为2）、3'剪接位点附近更复杂的二级结构，以及更大的分支点至3'剪接位点有效距离和GC二核苷酸的相对富集。讨论：这些特征汇聚于更弱、更难接近的剪接信号，这可能损害剪接位点识别并使结果偏向于保留。我们的工作识别了预测四膜虫内含子保留的关键序列水平特征，并可能为研究其他真核生物中的剪接调控提供一种可推广、可解释的机器学习框架。

papers.title: From reference-genome prediction to causal generalization: sequence-to-function models for plant regulatory genomics.
papers.authors: Zhan, Mingfang; Wu, Ruigang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述植物调控基因组学中序列-功能模型（seq2func）的泛化挑战，虽涉及顺式调控元件和调控序列设计，但未聚焦染色质三维空间架构建模，且为综述性文章，AI方法讨论较泛，与三维基因组建模课题关联有限。
papers.abstract: Sequence-to-function (seq2func) models predict molecular regulatory outputs from DNA sequence and can prioritize non-coding variants, annotate cis-regulatory elements (CREs), and design regulatory sequences. Although accuracy has improved, most models are trained and evaluated on observational data from one or a few reference genomes. Their performance may therefore not translate to natural haplotypes, structural variants, tissues, developmental stages, environments, or species. These limitations are especially important in plants, where pan-genomic diversity, transposable elements, polyploidy, long-range regulation, and genotype-by-environment interactions shape regulatory landscapes. This Mini Review summarizes seq2func modelling in plant regulatory genomics, discusses plant-specific challenges and the complementary value of observational and perturbation assays, and proposes evaluation frameworks based on biologically meaningful distribution shifts. We further outline how pan-genomes, multi-omics, genome editing, reporter assays, active learning, and continual learning could support closed-loop experimental-computational systems. Progress should be judged not only by reference-genome accuracy, but by calibrated and experimentally validated generalization across plant diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 序列到功能（seq2func）模型从DNA序列预测分子调控输出，可用于优先排序非编码变异、注释顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements, CREs）及设计调控序列。尽管准确性已有所提升，但大多数模型是在一个或少数参考基因组上的观测数据中训练和评估的。因此，其性能可能无法推广至自然单倍型、结构变异、组织、发育阶段、环境或物种。这些局限性在植物中尤为重要，因为泛基因组多样性、转座元件、多倍性、长距离调控以及基因型与环境的互作塑造了调控景观。本迷你综述总结了植物调控基因组学中的seq2func建模，讨论了植物特有的挑战以及观测和扰动实验的互补价值，并提出了基于生物学意义分布偏移的评估框架。我们进一步概述了泛基因组、多组学、基因组编辑、报告基因检测、主动学习和持续学习如何支持闭环实验-计算系统。进展不仅应依据参考基因组准确性来评判，还应依据经过校准和实验验证的跨植物多样性泛化能力来评判。

papers.title: Genetic risk and inflammatory signaling converge on cell type-specific regulatory programs in type 1 diabetes
papers.authors: Wang L; Wei Z
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文整合表观基因组与GWAS数据，用深度学习ChromBPNet预测T1D相关SNP对染色质可及性的影响，虽涉及染色质调控建模，但未聚焦三维基因组/染色质高级结构，方法可迁移性有限。
papers.abstract: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is a complex autoimmune disease characterized by the destruction of insulin-producing pancreatic β cells. Both genetic susceptibility and epigenetic dysregulation contribute to T1D risk. Recent studies have reported β-cell dysfunction before disease onset, suggesting that β-cell-intrinsic mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis. However, the mechanistic link between disease-associated variants and β-cell dysfunction remains poorly understood. We hypothesized that a subset of T1D-associated variants directly influences cell type-specific candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs) by disrupting transcription factor (TF) binding and altering gene expression. To define cell type-specific cCREs in human islets, we integrated publicly available epigenomic datasets, including bulk histone modification profiles and single-cell multiomic data from human pancreatic islets. We combined these data with T1D genome-wide association study (GWAS) variants to identify disease-associated SNPs located within enhancer regions. Using multiomic datasets from PANC-DB, we characterized cell type-specific chromatin accessibility in nondiabetic and T1D islets and identified regulatory regions that may control gene expression in β cells and other islet cell types. We then applied ChromBPNet, a deep learning model that predicts base-pair-resolution chromatin accessibility from scATAC-seq data, to evaluate how specific variants may alter local regulatory activity. In parallel, we used TF footprinting to nominate TFs likely to bind these variant-containing regions. These analyses identified several T1D-associated SNPs predicted to alter chromatin accessibility at candidate TF binding sites, suggesting mechanisms by which noncoding variants may contribute to β-cell dysfunction and T1D susceptibility. Our findings link T1D-associated variants to cell type-specific enhancer activity and regulatory pathways and provide candidates for future mechanistic studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 1型糖尿病（T1D）是一种复杂的自身免疫性疾病，其特征是产生胰岛素的胰腺β细胞被破坏。遗传易感性和表观遗传失调均促成T1D风险。近期研究报道了疾病发作前的β细胞功能障碍，提示β细胞内在机制参与发病过程。然而，疾病相关变异与β细胞功能障碍之间的机制联系仍知之甚少。我们假设，一部分T1D相关变异通过破坏转录因子（TF）结合并改变基因表达，直接影响细胞类型特异性的候选顺式调控元件（cCREs）。为定义人类胰岛中的细胞类型特异性cCREs，我们整合了公开可用的表观基因组数据集，包括来自人类胰腺胰岛的批量组蛋白修饰谱和单细胞多组学数据。我们将这些数据与T1D全基因组关联研究（GWAS）变异相结合，以识别位于增强子区域内的疾病相关SNP。利用PANC-DB的多组学数据集，我们表征了非糖尿病和T1D胰岛中的细胞类型特异性染色质可及性，并识别了可能控制β细胞及其他胰岛细胞类型基因表达的调控区域。随后，我们应用ChromBPNet（一种从scATAC-seq数据预测碱基对分辨率染色质可及性的深度学习模型）来评估特定变异如何改变局部调控活性。同时，我们使用TF足迹分析来提名可能结合这些含变异区域的TF。这些分析识别出若干T1D相关SNP，预测其会改变候选TF结合位点的染色质可及性，提示非编码变异可能促成β细胞功能障碍和T1D易感性的机制。我们的发现将T1D相关变异与细胞类型特异性增强子活性和调控通路联系起来，并为未来机制研究提供了候选靶点。

papers.title: CardioChrom Reconstructs the Human Cardiac Virtual Epigenome from Single-Nucleus Transcriptomes.
papers.authors: Huang, Hongbiao; Hui, Xiaodan; Li, Yingjian; Abdelbaset-Ismail, Ahmed; Xu, Zixuan; Yadav, Suchen; Tan, Yi
papers.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习从单核转录组重建心脏染色质可及性与组蛋白修饰，虽涉及染色质调控状态预测，但对象非三维基因组/染色质空间组织，且无三维架构建模或分子模拟方法，仅属表观基因组预测，与课题关联有限。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Matched epigenomic profiling remains scarce in human heart failure, limiting regulatory interpretation of single-nucleus ribonucleic acid (RNA) sequencing data. We developed CardioChrom, a cardiac-specialized framework that reconstructs chromatin accessibility, histone H3 lysine 27 acetylation (H3K27ac), and histone H3 lysine 27 trimethylation (H3K27me3) from single-nucleus RNA profiles. METHODS: CardioChrom was developed using same-nucleus human heart datasets jointly measuring RNA with chromatin accessibility by assay for transposase-accessible chromatin (ATAC), H3K27ac, or H3K27me3, with donor-separated development and leave-one-cell-type-out testing. Frozen models were evaluated in 10-donor and 23-sample external human heart cohorts. Histone reconstruction was benchmarked against measured profiles and a Transformer. The models were then applied without refitting to an RNA-only cohort of 43 donors with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). RESULTS: Across unseen cardiac cell types, CardioChrom increased area under the precision- recall curve by 0.0109 relative to within-cell-type RNA shuffling in 11 of 12 cell types and increased area under the receiver operating characteristic curve by 0.0179 in all 12.CardioChrom exceeded controls in both external cohorts and matched or exceeded the Transformer across 6 prespecified histone metrics. In HFpEF, 3,581 donor-level pathway-layer associations met global false discovery rate, sex-adjustment, and leave-one-donor-out robustness criteria. Endothelial cells showed prominent reconstructed histone-associated changes involving coagulation, inflammation, hypoxia, and profibrotic signaling. Von Willebrand factor expression and its reconstructed regulatory states were consistently reduced, and all 6 linked candidate cis-regulatory elements were classified as repressed. Motif-supported TF-cCRE-gene hypotheses were generated in endothelial cells and fibroblasts. CONCLUSIONS: CardioChrom extends RNA-only human heart failure cohorts toward cell-type-resolved virtual epigenomic and regulatory analysis while distinguishing predictions from direct measurements. CLINICAL PERSPECTIVE: What Is New?: CardioChrom is, to our knowledge, the first cardiac-specialized virtual epigenome framework to integrate same-nucleus human heart RNA-ATAC and RNA-histone reference data to reconstruct chromatin accessibility, H3K27ac, and H3K27me3 states from single-nucleus RNA profiles.The framework was tested beyond its training setting, including unseen donors, leave-one-cell-type-out evaluation, and independent human heart cohorts, and consistently exceeded simple RNA-shuffled or peak-frequency baselines while remaining competitive with or superior to Transformer-based comparators.What Are the Clinical Implications?: Many heart-failure cohorts contain transcriptomic data without matched epigenomic measurements. CardioChrom provides a way to extend these RNA-only datasets toward cell-type-resolved regulatory-state analysis without requiring additional tissue or multimodal assays.In an independent RNA-only HFpEF cohort, CardioChrom identified prominent endothelial regulatory remodeling involving Coagulation, IL6/JAK/STAT3, TNFalpha/NFkappaB, Hypoxia, and TGF-beta/EMT and generated TF-cCRE-gene hypotheses that can be prioritized for experimental validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：在人类心力衰竭中，匹配的表观基因组分析仍然稀缺，限制了对单核核糖核酸（RNA）测序数据的调控解读。我们开发了CardioChrom，一种心脏特化框架，可从单核RNA谱中重建染色质可及性、组蛋白H3赖氨酸27乙酰化（H3K27ac）和组蛋白H3赖氨酸27三甲基化（H3K27me3）。方法：CardioChrom利用同核人类心脏数据集开发，这些数据集同时测量RNA与通过转座酶可及染色质测定（ATAC）、H3K27ac或H3K27me3的染色质可及性，并进行供体分离开发和留一细胞类型测试。冻结模型在10供体和23样本的外部人类心脏队列中评估。组蛋白重建与测量谱和Transformer进行基准比较。随后，这些模型未经重新拟合应用于一个仅含RNA的43名射血分数保留型心力衰竭（HFpEF）供体队列。结果：在未见的心脏细胞类型中，CardioChrom在12种细胞类型中的11种中，相对于细胞类型内RNA打乱，将精确率-召回率曲线下面积提高了0.0109，并在全部12种中将受试者工作特征曲线下面积提高了0.0179。CardioChrom在两个外部队列中均超过对照组，并在6项预设组蛋白指标上与Transformer相当或超过。在HFpEF中，3,581个供体水平通路-层关联满足全局错误发现率、性别调整和留一供体稳健性标准。内皮细胞显示出突出的重建组蛋白相关变化，涉及凝血、炎症、缺氧和促纤维化信号。血管性血友病因子表达及其重建调控状态一致降低，所有6个关联候选顺式调控元件被分类为抑制状态。在内皮细胞和成纤维细胞中产生了基序支持的TF-cCRE-基因假设。结论：CardioChrom将仅含RNA的人类心力衰竭队列扩展至细胞类型分辨的虚拟表观基因组和调控分析，同时区分预测与直接测量。临床视角：新内容是什么？：据我们所知，CardioChrom是首个心脏特化的虚拟表观基因组框架，整合同核人类心脏RNA-ATAC和RNA-组蛋白参考数据，从单核RNA谱中重建染色质可及性、H3K27ac和H3K27me3状态。该框架在其训练设置之外进行了测试，包括未见供体、留一细胞类型评估和独立人类心脏队列，并始终超过简单的RNA打乱或峰频率基线，同时与基于Transformer的比较器保持竞争力或优于后者。临床意义是什么？：许多心力衰竭队列包含转录组数据，但缺乏匹配的表观基因组测量。CardioChrom提供了一种方法，将这些仅含RNA的数据集扩展至细胞类型分辨的调控状态分析，而无需额外组织或多模态测定。在一个独立的仅含RNA的HFpEF队列中，CardioChrom识别出涉及凝血、IL6/JAK/STAT3、TNFalpha/NFkappaB、缺氧和TGF-beta/EMT的突出内皮调控重塑，并生成了可优先用于实验验证的TF-cCRE-基因假设。

papers.title: MMP2Mol: a matched molecular pairs-based framework for ligand-based de novo drug design.
papers.authors: Chen, Dekun; Li, Hui; Liu, Jianwang; Jiang, Yueping; Cao, Dongsheng; Liu, Shao
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于匹配分子对与化学语言模型的配体药物设计框架，对象为小分子生成而非染色质/三维基因组，且无空间架构建模或可迁移的染色质组织方法，仅与AI生成方法有微弱关联。
papers.abstract: Designing target-relevant molecules is particularly difficult when only limited bioactivity data are available. We present MMP2Mol, a ligand-based generative framework that combines matched molecular pair (MMP) analysis with a pretrained chemical language model (CLM). MMP2Mol extracts target-specific structure-activity transformations from available ligands, applies the prioritized transformations to construct a virtual focused library, and fine-tunes the CLM toward target-relevant chemical space. The framework was evaluated across ten therapeutic targets and compared with direct CLM fine-tuning, Seq2Seq, and Reinvent 4. In repeated experiments on F2, BRD4, and PARP1, MMP2Mol achieved 92.8%-95.3% validity and 99.5%-99.7% uniqueness. When both methods were evaluated against the same original active-compound reference, molecular novelty increased from 57.8%-64.0% for the CLM baseline to 79.8%-82.0% for MMP2Mol, while internal diversity remained broadly comparable. The gains were most evident for F2 and BRD4, whereas performance varied across the smaller target datasets. These findings indicate that MMP-derived chemical knowledge can improve the focus and reproducibility of ligand-based molecular generation under limited-data conditions. MMP2Mol therefore provides a practical strategy for computational candidate generation and prioritization in early-stage drug discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 当仅有有限的生物活性数据可用时，设计靶标相关分子尤为困难。我们提出了MMP2Mol，一种基于配体的生成框架，它将匹配分子对（MMP）分析与预训练的化学语言模型（CLM）相结合。MMP2Mol从可用配体中提取靶标特异性的结构-活性转换，应用优先排序的转换构建虚拟聚焦库，并微调CLM以朝向靶标相关的化学空间。该框架在十个治疗靶标上进行了评估，并与直接CLM微调、Seq2Seq和Reinvent 4进行了比较。在F2、BRD4和PARP1的重复实验中，MMP2Mol实现了92.8%-95.3%的有效性和99.5%-99.7%的独特性。当两种方法针对相同的原始活性化合物参考进行评估时，分子新颖性从CLM基线的57.8%-64.0%增加到MMP2Mol的79.8%-82.0%，而内部多样性保持大致相当。这些增益在F2和BRD4上最为显著，而在较小的靶标数据集上性能有所变化。这些发现表明，MMP衍生的化学知识可以在有限数据条件下提高基于配体的分子生成的聚焦性和可重复性。因此，MMP2Mol为早期药物发现中的计算候选生成和优先级排序提供了一种实用策略。

papers.title: EpiZoo: a DNA sequence-aware foundation model for cross-species single-cell epigenomics
papers.authors: Li K; Chen X; Jiang Q; Wang Z; Lv H; Jiang R
papers.one_liner_zh: EpiZoo是一个跨物种单细胞表观基因组学的DNA序列感知基础模型，虽涉及染色质可及性调控，但主要聚焦单细胞分析任务而非三维染色质空间架构建模，方法上AI可迁移但对象和结构轴较弱。
papers.abstract: Large-scale single-cell epigenomic atlases characterize chromatin regulatory landscapes across diverse biological contexts, spanning cell types, tissues, individuals and species. Foundation models provide an opportunity to capture the full spectrum of cellular diversity in these atlases, yet current models remain largely confined to individual species by genomic coordinate dependence and overlook regulatory information encoded in DNA sequences. Here we introduce EpiZoo, a DNA sequence-aware foundation model for cross-species single-cell epigenomics. EpiZoo converts million-dimensional single-cell epigenomic profiles from diverse species into compact cell sentences that integrate DNA-encoded regulatory information, sequence-independent epigenomic context and accessibility-based importance. Built around a mixture-of-experts transformer and containing 2.6 billion parameters in total, EpiZoo is pretrained on our manually curated multi-species Omni-scATAC corpus of approximately 20.9 million cells to learn regulatory programs across species. On external datasets excluded from pretraining, EpiZoo achieves state-of-the-art performance in fundamental single-cell analysis tasks, including feature extraction, cell type annotation and data imputation. Its sequence-aware architecture enables extension to evolutionarily diverse species, and supports comparative analysis of regulatory conservation and divergence during primate evolution. Benefiting from this modeling design, EpiZoo enables context-aware prioritization of somatic mutations in cancer and prediction of cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility from DNA sequences across genomic regions and species.
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模单细胞表观基因组图谱描绘了跨越细胞类型、组织、个体和物种等多种生物学背景下的染色质调控景观。基础模型为捕捉这些图谱中细胞多样性的全谱提供了机会，然而现有模型因基因组坐标依赖性而主要局限于单个物种，并忽视了DNA序列中编码的调控信息。在此，我们介绍了EpiZoo，一种面向跨物种单细胞表观基因组学的DNA序列感知基础模型。EpiZoo将来自不同物种的百万维单细胞表观基因组谱转化为紧凑的细胞句子，这些句子整合了DNA编码的调控信息、序列无关的表观基因组背景以及基于可及性的重要性。EpiZoo围绕混合专家变换器构建，总参数达26亿，在我们手动整理的多物种Omni-scATAC语料库（约2090万个细胞）上进行预训练，以学习跨物种的调控程序。在预训练未涉及的外部数据集上，EpiZoo在基础单细胞分析任务中达到了最先进性能，包括特征提取、细胞类型注释和数据插补。其序列感知架构使其能够扩展到进化上多样的物种，并支持灵长类进化过程中调控保守性和分歧的比较分析。得益于这种建模设计，EpiZoo能够实现癌症中体细胞突变的情境感知优先级排序，以及从DNA序列跨基因组区域和物种预测细胞类型特异性的染色质可及性。

papers.title: Deep Learning Predicts Hematopoietic Stem Cell Aging From 3D Chromatin Images.
papers.authors: Picazo, Pablo Ianez; Mejia-Ramirez, Eva; Di Bari, Dario; Vitali, Elena; Florian, Maria Carolina; Petrone, Paula
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用CNN从3D染色质图像预测造血干细胞衰老，虽对象为染色质组织且用深度学习方法，但聚焦衰老表型而非三维基因组结构（TAD/环等）建模，方法可迁移但结构/调控深度有限。
papers.abstract: The functional decline of the hematopoietic system during aging affects organismal function and contributes to reduced healthspan. Quantifying hematopoietic aging holds great scientific and clinical relevance. Alterations in chromatin architecture are a well-established hallmark of aging that encode rich and informative signatures of the aging process, yet they remain largely unexplored as quantitative markers. Here, we present an interpretable deep learning approach based on convolutional neural networks, ChromAgeNet, that learns changes in the spatial features of chromatin architecture upon aging of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs). We trained our algorithm on 3D microscope images of DAPI-stained HSC nuclei to discriminate between young and aged murine HSCs, achieving an AUROC of 0.77 +/- 0.03. This approach outperforms classical machine learning models trained on handcrafted chromatin features from the same dataset. We then applied explainable artificial intelligence techniques, identifying chromatin entropy, peripheral heterochromatin, and chromatin condensates as predictive markers. As a proof of concept, we evaluated the potential of our model as a phenotypic screening tool for aged HSCs treated with epigenetic drugs to detect rejuvenation. Altogether, we demonstrate that changes in chromatin organization can be modeled via machine learning to predict age-associated chromatin states in the hematopoietic compartment. Our developed framework, ChromAgeNet, serves as an interpretable algorithm to unravel the intricate relationship between chromatin changes and stem cell aging, and advance high-throughput drug screening for rejuvenation therapies.
papers.abstract_zh: 衰老过程中造血系统的功能衰退会影响机体功能，并导致健康寿命缩短。量化造血系统衰老具有重要的科学和临床意义。染色质结构的改变是公认的衰老标志，编码了衰老过程中丰富且信息量大的特征，但作为定量标记仍鲜有探索。在此，我们提出一种基于卷积神经网络的可解释深度学习方法ChromAgeNet，用于学习造血干细胞（HSCs）衰老过程中染色质结构空间特征的变化。我们在DAPI染色的HSC细胞核三维显微镜图像上训练算法，以区分年轻和年老小鼠HSCs，实现了0.77 +/- 0.03的AUROC。该方法优于在同一数据集上基于手工染色质特征训练的经典机器学习模型。随后，我们应用可解释人工智能技术，识别出染色质熵、外周异染色质和染色质凝聚体作为预测标记。作为概念验证，我们评估了模型作为表型筛选工具的潜力，用于检测经表观遗传药物处理的年老HSCs的年轻化效果。总体而言，我们证明了染色质组织的变化可通过机器学习建模，以预测造血区室中与年龄相关的染色质状态。我们开发的框架ChromAgeNet作为一种可解释算法，有助于揭示染色质变化与干细胞衰老之间的复杂关系，并推进年轻化疗法的高通量药物筛选。

papers.title: CTCF-FXN regulatory axis plays critical roles in clinical assessments and disease progression of primary open-angle glaucoma.
papers.authors: Cai, Danrui; Yu, Yao; Ma, Junze; Li, Ting; Liu, Ziyao
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究青光眼中CTCF对FXN的转录调控及氧化应激机制，虽涉及CTCF但无染色质三维结构建模，且无AI/分子模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) is an irreversible ophthalmic disease that is the leading cause of blindness. Oxidative stress (OS) is considered an important contributor to POAG pathogenesis. However, its mechanism of action in POAG remains vague. FXN was identified as a candidate OS-related gene associated with POAG through WGCNA and two machine learning methods (LASSO regression and SVM-RFE). Through multiple bioinformatic analyses, FXN exhibited potential diagnostic value and was associated with immune-related signatures in POAG samples. GSEA revealed that high FXN expression was associated with enrichment of glycolysis- and pyruvate metabolism-related gene sets. FXN expression was significantly decreased in an H2O2 in vitro model (R28 cells). CCK8, EdU, TUNEL, ROS detection and flow cytometry assays indicated that FXN overexpression improved retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) viability and inhibited cell apoptosis and ROS accumulation. Mechanistically, CTCF was demonstrated to transcriptionally regulate FXN by binding to its promoter region, as confirmed by ChIP assay. FXN deletion partially abolished the protective effects of CTCF overexpression on RGC viability, apoptosis, and oxidative stress responses. In conclusions, FXN may represent a potential biomarker associated with POAG. The identification of the CTCF-FXN regulatory axis provides new insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying POAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 原发性开角型青光眼（POAG）是一种不可逆的眼科疾病，是导致失明的主要原因。氧化应激（OS）被认为是POAG发病机制中的重要因素。然而，其在POAG中的作用机制仍不明确。通过WGCNA和两种机器学习方法（LASSO回归和SVM-RFE），FXN被鉴定为与POAG相关的候选OS相关基因。通过多种生物信息学分析，FXN在POAG样本中表现出潜在的诊断价值，并与免疫相关特征相关联。GSEA显示，FXN高表达与糖酵解和丙酮酸代谢相关基因集的富集有关。在H2O2体外模型（R28细胞）中，FXN表达显著降低。CCK8、EdU、TUNEL、ROS检测和流式细胞术分析表明，FXN过表达提高了视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）的活力，并抑制了细胞凋亡和ROS积累。在机制上，ChIP实验证实CTCF通过结合其启动子区域对FXN进行转录调控。FXN缺失部分消除了CTCF过表达对RGC活力、凋亡和氧化应激反应的保护作用。总之，FXN可能代表与POAG相关的潜在生物标志物。CTCF-FXN调控轴的鉴定为理解POAG的分子机制提供了新见解。

papers.title: TAD boundary disruption in Xq27-q28 deletions rewires 3D chromatin architecture and may predispose to primary skewed X chromosome inactivation.
papers.authors: Katoh, Kimiko; Nishide, Hiroyo; Hamaguchi, Yu; Soga, Minami; Aiba, Kaori; Kato, Kagayaki; Tsutsumi, Motosuke; Sakamoto, Joe; Solovieva, Elena; Nemoto, Tomomi; Era, Takumi; Hamada, Michiaki; Uchiyama, Ikuo; Wakamatsu, Nobuaki; Asai, Masato
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究利用深度学习模型Orca预测Xq27-q28缺失导致的TAD边界破坏与neo-TAD形成，并结合Hi-C和3D DNA-FISH验证其对X染色体失活偏斜的影响，直接涉及染色质三维架构建模与调控功能关联。
papers.abstract: In placental females, X chromosome inactivation (XCI) establishes random monoallelic expression as XIST RNA spreads along a pre-existing three-dimensional (3D) chromatin contact network. How structural variants reshape this 3D landscape to influence XCI choice remains unclear. We previously reported two female individuals with overlapping Xq27-q28 deletions but discordant XCI, skewed in one and random in the other. By re-evaluating 17 reported cases, we found that skewing in a subset was not readily explained by classical routes of primary bias from the canonical XCI machinery or by secondary cell selection. Using the deep-learning model Orca, we predicted that the deletion in the skewed case would fuse disparate topologically associating domains (TADs) into a neo-TAD. Analysis of human preimplantation Hi-C data showed that the relevant TAD boundaries were already apparent by the 8-cell stage, before stable XCI. 3D DNA-FISH revealed reduced spatial distances between selected loci, consistent with the Orca-predicted neo-TAD architecture, in patient-derived naive iPSCs and lymphoblastoid cells. Orca-predicted neo-TAD formation was also identified in three of six random-XCI cases, indicating that it is insufficient on its own to bias XCI. We identified 86 candidate Polycomb-associated loci with chromatin features consistent with Polycomb seed sites on the human X chromosome. The skewed case showed the most extensive disruption of these candidate loci, although candidate-locus disruption was also observed in random-XCI cases. We therefore propose a working seed convergence model in which the convergence of predicted neo-TAD formation and extensive disruption of candidate Polycomb-associated loci may predispose to skewed XCI.
papers.abstract_zh: 在胎盘雌性个体中，X染色体失活（XCI）通过XIST RNA沿预先存在的三维（3D）染色质接触网络传播，建立随机的单等位基因表达。结构变异如何重塑这一3D景观以影响XCI选择仍不清楚。我们此前报道了两名携带重叠Xq27-q28缺失但XCI不一致的女性个体，其中一例表现为偏斜，另一例为随机。通过重新评估17例已报道病例，我们发现部分病例中的偏斜现象无法轻易通过经典XCI机制的初级偏斜途径或继发性细胞选择来解释。使用深度学习模型Orca，我们预测偏斜病例中的缺失会将不相连的拓扑关联结构域（TADs）融合成一个新TAD（neo-TAD）。对人类植入前Hi-C数据的分析显示，相关TAD边界在8细胞阶段已明显存在，早于稳定XCI的发生。3D DNA-FISH显示，在患者来源的初始态iPSCs和淋巴母细胞中，选定基因座之间的空间距离减小，与Orca预测的新TAD结构一致。在六例随机XCI病例中，有三例也检测到Orca预测的新TAD形成，表明其本身不足以偏倚XCI。我们在人类X染色体上鉴定了86个候选Polycomb相关基因座，其染色质特征与Polycomb种子位点一致。偏斜病例显示出这些候选基因座最广泛的破坏，尽管在随机XCI病例中也观察到候选基因座破坏。因此，我们提出一个工作性的种子汇聚模型，其中预测的新TAD形成与候选Polycomb相关基因座的广泛破坏的汇聚可能易导致XCI偏斜。

papers.title: Mechanism of SGLT2 inhibitors in improving immune imbalance in diabetic mice with sepsis via regulating macrophage M2 polarization through the APOC1/HMGB1/TLR4 axis.
papers.authors: You, TingTing; Yang, HuoBao; Chen, Gang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨SGLT2抑制剂通过APOC1/HMGB1/TLR4轴调节巨噬细胞极化改善脓毒症合并糖尿病小鼠免疫失衡，属于免疫炎症机制研究，与三维基因组/染色质组织建模及AI/分子模拟方法无关。
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the mechanism by which the sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor dapagliflozin improves immune imbalance in sepsis with diabetes, focusing on its regulation of macrophage M2 polarization through the APOC1/HMGB1/TLR4 axis. A mouse model of type 2 diabetes was established through intraperitoneal injection of streptozotocin, after which sepsis was induced by cecal ligation and puncture. For in vitro studies, RAW264.7 macrophages and bone marrow-derived macrophages were exposed to high glucose and lipopolysaccharide. Molecular docking was employed to examine potential binding between dapagliflozin and APOC1. Organ pathology in lung, liver, and kidney was evaluated using hematoxylin and eosin staining and biochemical assay kits. Expression levels of APOC1, HMGB1, TLR4, and macrophage M1/M2 markers were analyzed via immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence. Inflammatory cytokine levels were quantified with enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. The SGLT2 inhibitor dapagliflozin effectively alleviated lung, liver, kidney injury and dysfunction and reduced inflammatory responses in diabetic mice with sepsis. The treatment also decreased inflammatory cytokine levels in the high glucose/lipopolysaccharide-stimulated cellular model. Furthermore, dapagliflozin treatment significantly increased the levels of M2 macrophage markers in both in vivo and in vitro models. Mechanistically, dapagliflozin was found to target, bind to, and downregulate APOC1 expression. Further investigations revealed that APOC1 promotes macrophage M1 polarization via the APOC1/HMGB1/TLR4 axis, an effect reversed by dapagliflozin. The SGLT2 inhibitor dapagliflozin ameliorates organ damage and inflammation in sepsis with diabetes by promoting macrophage M2 polarization through inhibition of the APOC1/HMGB1/TLR4 axis.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2（SGLT2）抑制剂达格列净改善脓毒症合并糖尿病免疫失衡的机制，重点关注其通过APOC1/HMGB1/TLR4轴调控巨噬细胞M2极化。通过腹腔注射链脲佐菌素建立2型糖尿病小鼠模型，随后采用盲肠结扎穿刺法诱导脓毒症。体外研究中，RAW264.7巨噬细胞和骨髓来源巨噬细胞暴露于高糖和脂多糖。采用分子对接 (molecular docking) 检测达格列净与APOC1之间的潜在结合。肺、肝和肾的器官病理通过苏木精-伊红染色和生化检测试剂盒评估。APOC1、HMGB1、TLR4及巨噬细胞M1/M2标志物的表达水平通过免疫组织化学和免疫荧光分析。炎症细胞因子水平通过酶联免疫吸附测定 (enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay) 定量。SGLT2抑制剂达格列净有效减轻了脓毒症合并糖尿病小鼠的肺、肝、肾损伤及功能障碍，并降低了炎症反应。该治疗还降低了高糖/脂多糖刺激细胞模型中的炎症细胞因子水平。此外，达格列净处理在体内和体外模型中均显著增加了M2巨噬细胞标志物的水平。机制上，达格列净被发现可靶向结合并下调APOC1表达。进一步研究表明，APOC1通过APOC1/HMGB1/TLR4轴促进巨噬细胞M1极化，而达格列净可逆转此效应。SGLT2抑制剂达格列净通过抑制APOC1/HMGB1/TLR4轴促进巨噬细胞M2极化，从而改善脓毒症合并糖尿病的器官损伤和炎症。

papers.title: Advances in single-cell and spatial multi-omics for plant development and stress responses.
papers.authors: Xu, Ping; Wang, Baozheng; Hu, Yanting; Qiong, La; Zhang, Ticao
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦植物单细胞与空间多组学技术及其计算整合，虽涉及染色质可及性和基因组组织，但未进行染色质三维空间架构建模，且缺乏AI/分子模拟方法贡献，与本课题关联较弱。
papers.abstract: Recent advances in single-cell and spatial multi-omics have enabled high-resolution profiling of plant cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) captures transcriptional variation across cell types and states, while single-nucleus ATAC sequencing (snATAC-seq) provides information on chromatin accessibility and regulatory elements. Spatial transcriptomics (ST) and spatial metabolomics preserve spatial context, enabling in situ mapping of molecular and metabolic features in plant tissues. This review summarizes experimental and computational approaches for these technologies in plants, with emphasis on their applicability and limitations under plant-specific constraints such as cell wall structure, tissue complexity, and genome organization. We further discuss computational integration strategies, including deconvolution, spatial mapping, and cross-modal representation learning, highlighting dependence on reference quality and challenges related to data sparsity and batch effects. We also consider current limitations in applying foundation models to plant data due to limited plant-specific training resources and differences in regulatory architecture across species. Finally, we highlight challenges in extending these approaches to non-model plants and emphasize the need for improved reference resources, standardized analytical frameworks, and robust validation strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 单细胞与空间多组学的最新进展使得对植物细胞异质性和组织结构的高分辨率解析成为可能。单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）捕获了不同细胞类型和状态下的转录变异，而单核ATAC测序（snATAC-seq）则提供了染色质可及性和调控元件的信息。空间转录组学（ST）和空间代谢组学保留了空间背景，使得植物组织中分子和代谢特征的原位定位成为可能。本综述总结了这些技术在植物中的实验和计算方法，重点强调了它们在植物特定限制条件下的适用性和局限性，这些限制包括细胞壁结构、组织复杂性和基因组组织。我们进一步讨论了计算整合策略，包括去卷积、空间映射和跨模态表示学习，并强调了它们对参考质量的依赖以及与数据稀疏性和批次效应相关的挑战。我们还考虑了当前将基础模型应用于植物数据时的局限性，这源于植物特异性训练资源的有限性以及物种间调控架构的差异。最后，我们指出了将这些方法扩展到非模式植物所面临的挑战，并强调了改进参考资源、标准化分析框架和稳健验证策略的必要性。

papers.title: Euchromatin forms condensed domains with short active regions on the surface.
papers.authors: Paggi, Joseph M; Long, Lawrence Y; Zhang, Bin
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发了基于micro-C接触图的模拟框架，在核小体分辨率下推断常染色质构象系综，揭示常染色质形成致密结构域且活性调控区突出于表面，直接涉及染色质三维组织与增强子-启动子空间互作的建模，与本课题高度契合。
papers.abstract: The three-dimensional organization of enhancers and promoters at nucleosome resolution remains poorly resolved, limiting our understanding of the structural basis of transcriptional regulation. Here, we developed a simulation framework that leverages region-capture micro-C contact maps to infer conformational ensembles of megabase-scale regions at nucleosome resolution. A key component of this framework is a micro-C balancing strategy that identifies variation in contact density. The simulations reproduce pairwise distance distributions measured by chromatin tracing and contain packing domains and nucleosome clutches, as observed in imaging studies. The inferred structures reveal a striking departure from the classical view of euchromatin as uniformly open. Instead, euchromatin generally forms condensed domains with comparable densities but smaller sizes than heterochromatin domains. Kilobase-scale regions at promoters and enhancers often protrude from these condensed domains and become highly accessible. This arrangement effectively compartmentalizes regulatory elements from the surrounding chromatin, facilitating protein binding and enhancer-promoter communication.
papers.abstract_zh: 增强子和启动子在核小体分辨率下的三维组织仍未被充分解析，限制了我们对转录调控结构基础的理解。在此，我们开发了一个模拟框架，利用区域捕获微C接触图谱来推断兆碱基规模区域在核小体分辨率下的构象集合。该框架的一个关键组成部分是微C平衡策略，用于识别接触密度的变异。模拟重现了通过染色质追踪测量的成对距离分布，并包含成像研究中观察到的堆积域和核小体簇。推断的结构揭示了真染色质经典视图（即均匀开放）的显著偏离。相反，真染色质通常形成致密域，其密度与异染色质域相当，但尺寸更小。启动子和增强子处的千碱基规模区域常从这些致密域中突出，变得高度可及。这种排列有效地将调控元件与周围染色质分隔开来，促进蛋白质结合及增强子-启动子通信。

papers.title: Machine learning and statistical methods for molecular quantitative trait loci.
papers.authors: Engelhardt, Barbara E; Weinstock, Joshua S; Nyquist, Sarah K; Battle, Alexis
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文综述用于分子数量性状位点（molQTL）定位的机器学习与统计方法，涉及染色质可及性等分子表型，但核心是遗传变异-表型关联而非染色质三维空间架构建模，与课题关联有限。
papers.abstract: An important goal of biology is to understand how genetic variation translates into molecular and then broader phenotypic variation. Quantitative trait locus (QTL) mapping studies are designed to statistically test the relationship between genetic and phenotypic variation, with molecular QTLs (molQTLs) capturing genetic effects on molecular traits, such as gene expression or chromatin accessibility, as the variable phenotypes of interest. Technological advances have provided molQTL mapping methods with increased molecular phenotypes to test, as well as larger cohorts, the latter of which provides greater statistical power to associate genetic variants with these phenotypes. With these advances, statistical models - and, increasingly, machine learning methods - are being developed to improve standard molQTL mapping approaches, downstream analyses and other aspects of molQTL studies to gain additional insights into the mechanisms connecting genetic and phenotypic variation, especially in a gene regulatory context.
papers.abstract_zh: 生物学的一个重要目标是理解遗传变异如何转化为分子变异，进而转化为更广泛的表型变异。数量性状位点（QTL）定位研究旨在统计检验遗传变异与表型变异之间的关系，其中分子QTL（molQTL）捕捉遗传效应对分子性状（如基因表达或染色质可及性）的影响，将这些作为关注的变量表型。技术进步为molQTL定位方法提供了更多可检验的分子表型，以及更大的队列，后者提供了更强的统计功效，以将遗传变异与这些表型关联起来。随着这些进展，统计模型——以及日益增多的机器学习方法——正在被开发，以改进标准的molQTL定位方法、下游分析及molQTL研究的其他方面，从而更深入地理解连接遗传变异与表型变异的机制，尤其是在基因调控背景下。

papers.title: Comprehensive Characterization of Cytochrome P450s Reveals Candidate Enzymes Involved in the Metabolic Fate of Absorbed Volatile Organic Compounds in Potato.
papers.authors: Bogdanovic, Milica D; Devrnja, Nina; Cukovic Janicijevic, Katarina B; Stupar, Sofija; Todorovic, Sladana I; Savic, Jelena
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究马铃薯细胞色素P450酶对挥发性有机物的代谢，虽含机器学习与分子对接，但对象非染色质/三维基因组，且无空间架构建模，仅边缘相关。
papers.abstract: Plants are continuously exposed to volatile organic compounds (VOCs) emitted by neighbors. Although the mechanisms governing VOC uptake and metabolism remain unclear, cytochrome P450 monooxygenases (CYP450s) are thought to participate in the detoxification and metabolic conversion of absorbed VOCs. Data from previously conducted cDNA microarray transcriptomic profiling in potato exposed to French marigold essential oil (FM-EO) was here used to filter differentially expressed sequences, and identified 54 unique CYP450 transcripts. Among the 10 most highly expressed sequences, two CYP81D1-like (81D1-1 and 81D1-2) and one CYP81D11-like (81D11-1) transcripts were found. RT-qPCR confirmed their strong induction within 8 h of volatile exposure. Comprehensive bioinformatics identified the most highly induced 81D1-1 gene as a CYP450 containing a predicted N-terminal hydrophobic signal or membrane-anchor region, the conserved heme-binding signature motif, and regulatory elements associated with oxidative stress responses. The other 81D11-1 gene, exhibiting a comparable expression level, was annotated only as a heme-binding protein but possessed seven distinct cis-regulatory elements, suggesting high transcriptional plasticity. Machine learning predictions assigned the highest interaction probability to (Z)-beta-ocimene, whereas structure-based docking yielded the most favorable mean score for piperitone. This study provides the first characterization of the potato CYP450 superfamily in the context of volatile-mediated plant-plant interactions and identifies two CYP81D members as strong candidates for the oxidative metabolism of absorbed VOCs. The results support a proposed detoxification pathway in which CYP81-mediated oxidation precedes glutathione conjugation and intracellular sequestration of VOCs. These candidate genes provide a valuable foundation for future functional studies and may facilitate the development of sustainable crop protection strategies based on volatile-mediated plant defense.
papers.abstract_zh: 植物持续暴露于邻近植物释放的挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）。尽管调控VOC吸收和代谢的机制尚不明确，但细胞色素P450单加氧酶（CYP450s）被认为参与吸收VOCs的解毒和代谢转化。本研究利用先前在马铃薯暴露于法国万寿菊精油（FM-EO）时进行的cDNA微阵列转录组谱分析数据，筛选差异表达序列，并鉴定出54个独特的CYP450转录本。在10个最高表达序列中，发现两个CYP81D1类似（81D1-1和81D1-2）转录本和一个CYP81D11类似（81D11-1）转录本。RT-qPCR证实它们在挥发性暴露8小时内被强烈诱导。综合生物信息学分析将诱导最强的81D1-1基因鉴定为一个CYP450，其包含预测的N端疏水信号或膜锚定区域、保守的血红素结合特征基序以及与氧化应激反应相关的调控元件。另一个表达水平相当的81D11-1基因仅被注释为血红素结合蛋白，但具有七个不同的顺式调控元件，表明其具有较高的转录可塑性。机器学习预测将最高相互作用概率分配给（Z）-β-罗勒烯，而基于结构的对接对胡椒酮给出了最有利的平均得分。本研究首次在挥发性介导的植物间相互作用背景下表征了马铃薯CYP450超家族，并鉴定出两个CYP81D成员作为吸收VOCs氧化代谢的强候选基因。结果支持一个提出的解毒途径，其中CYP81介导的氧化先于谷胱甘肽结合和VOCs的细胞内隔离。这些候选基因为未来的功能研究提供了宝贵基础，并可能促进基于挥发性介导植物防御的可持续作物保护策略的开发。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Assisted Prioritization of Candidate Drug Targets in Tumors Using Spatial Multi-Omics.
papers.authors: Liu, Yuxian; Zhou, Xueyan; Zhang, Junyuan; Liu, Guochao; Cao, Yanni
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦空间多组学与深度学习在肿瘤药物靶点优先排序中的应用，虽涉及染色质可及性等表观信息，但核心是肿瘤靶点发现而非染色质三维组织建模，且无AI/分子模拟方法贡献。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Tumor heterogeneity is reflected in cell composition, molecular states, spatial distribution, and microenvironment interactions. Spatial transcriptomics can map in situ expression and cell states but cannot fully explain upstream regulation, while spatial epigenomics provides complementary evidence such as chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, and deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) methylation. This review summarizes the applications of spatial multi-omics and deep learning in prioritizing candidate drug targets in tumors. METHODS: We reviewed spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics, and combined sequencing technologies, with a focus on how deep learning supports the analysis and integration of spatial multi-omics data for candidate-target prioritization. RESULTS: Deep learning facilitates the detection of abnormal regions, deciphering of cell origins, integration across samples, inference of cell-cell communication, and combination of imaging with omics data. Spatial multi-omics studies provide therapeutic insights into malignant cells, immunosuppression, stromal and vascular remodeling, and invasion and metastasis niches. Based on these applications, candidate targets can be evaluated in a layered manner according to spatial specificity, cell origin, regulatory consistency, reproducibility across patients, functional dependency, disease relevance, and druggability. CONCLUSIONS: Spatial multi-omics and deep learning can enhance the systematic and interpretable selection of candidate targets. However, computational associations cannot replace functional validation. Candidate targets still require verification through gene perturbation, drug sensitivity assays, organoids, animal models, and clinical cohorts to confirm their therapeutic potential.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的：肿瘤异质性体现在细胞组成、分子状态、空间分布及微环境相互作用中。空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics）能够绘制原位表达和细胞状态，但无法完全解释上游调控，而空间表观基因组学（spatial epigenomics）提供了补充证据，如染色质可及性、组蛋白修饰和脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）甲基化。本综述总结了空间多组学和深度学习在肿瘤候选药物靶点优先排序中的应用。方法：我们综述了空间转录组学、空间表观基因组学及联合测序技术，重点关注深度学习如何支持空间多组学数据的分析和整合，以用于候选靶点的优先排序。结果：深度学习有助于检测异常区域、解析细胞起源、跨样本整合、推断细胞间通讯，以及将影像与组学数据结合。空间多组学研究为恶性细胞、免疫抑制、基质和血管重塑、侵袭及转移微环境提供了治疗见解。基于这些应用，候选靶点可根据空间特异性、细胞起源、调控一致性、跨患者可重复性、功能依赖性、疾病相关性和可成药性进行分层评估。结论：空间多组学和深度学习能够增强候选靶点选择的系统性和可解释性。然而，计算关联不能替代功能验证。候选靶点仍需通过基因扰动、药物敏感性测定、类器官、动物模型和临床队列进行验证，以确认其治疗潜力。

papers.title: Cross-Model Uncertainty-Aware Minimal Editing of Cis-Regulatory Elements for Cell-Type-Selective Design.
papers.authors: Xia, Angran; Wang, Changwei; Xia, Yemao
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用AI序列-活性模型与不确定性感知的编辑策略设计顺式调控元件（CRE）变体库，虽涉及染色质水平调控元件设计，但聚焦序列编辑而非三维空间架构建模，方法可迁移性中等。
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Cis-regulatory elements (CREs) help mediate cell-type-selective gene expression, yet sequence-to-activity models are rarely converted into compact, experimentally tractable variant panels that retain natural regulatory scaffolds. We developed SafeEdit-CRE to select minimal edits that preserve cross-model specificity while reducing predictive uncertainty, yielding an auditable CRE variant library for reporter-screening prioritization. Methods: SafeEdit-CRE combines the published Malinois sequence-activity predictor with an architecture-distinct reviewer ensemble, validation-calibrated uncertainty, sequence-domain controls, and constrained beam search. Natural 200 nt CREs were edited under fixed substitution budgets of 1, 5, 10, or 20 nucleotides and evaluated by a separately trained multi-kernel ensemble kept entirely separate from candidate generation. Results: Across 600 held-out CRE parents in K562, HepG2, and SK-N-SH cells, SafeEdit-CRE achieved a mean cross-model specificity-margin gain of 0.877 versus 0.822 for greedy editing (paired difference 0.055; 95% CI 0.040-0.071). Relative to a compute-matched primary-model beam, SafeEdit-CRE yielded a similar cross-model specificity-margin gain (difference -0.004; 95% CI -0.011-0.004) with lower ensemble uncertainty (0.314 vs. 0.335). In a locked 90-parent benchmark, 60.6% of designs passed all nine prespecified sequence and model-agreement checks, compared with 38.8% for greedy and 13.1% for random substitution (paired difference 21.8 percentage points; 95% CI 18.3-25.3). Conclusions: SafeEdit-CRE reduced 3240 designs to 74 Tier A computational candidates prioritized for reporter screening across three cell types and four edit budgets. By separating search from cross-model audit and enforcing explicit edit budgets and sequence-domain safeguards, the framework provides a reproducible and auditable approach to computational CRE prioritization, regulatory-grammar studies, and synthetic regulatory-element design.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标：顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements, CREs）有助于介导细胞类型选择性基因表达，然而序列到活性模型很少被转化为紧凑且实验上可操作的变异面板，同时保留天然调控支架。我们开发了SafeEdit-CRE，用于选择最小编辑，在降低预测不确定性的同时保持跨模型特异性，从而生成一个可审计的CRE变异文库，用于报告基因筛选优先级排序。方法：SafeEdit-CRE结合了已发表的Malinois序列活性预测器与架构不同的评审集成、验证校准的不确定性、序列域控制以及约束束搜索。在固定的1、5、10或20个核苷酸替换预算下，对天然的200 nt CRE进行编辑，并由一个单独训练的多核集成进行评估，该集成与候选生成完全分离。结果：在K562、HepG2和SK-N-SH细胞中的600个保留CRE亲本中，SafeEdit-CRE实现了平均跨模型特异性边际增益0.877，而贪婪编辑为0.822（配对差异0.055；95% CI 0.040-0.071）。相对于计算匹配的主模型束，SafeEdit-CRE产生了相似的跨模型特异性边际增益（差异-0.004；95% CI -0.011-0.004），且集成不确定性更低（0.314对0.335）。在一个锁定的90亲本基准中，60.6%的设计通过了所有九项预设序列和模型一致性检查，而贪婪编辑为38.8%，随机替换为13.1%（配对差异21.8个百分点；95% CI 18.3-25.3）。结论：SafeEdit-CRE将3240个设计缩减为74个Tier A计算候选，优先用于三种细胞类型和四种编辑预算下的报告基因筛选。通过将搜索与跨模型审计分离，并强制执行明确的编辑预算和序列域保障措施，该框架为计算CRE优先级排序、调控语法研究和合成调控元件设计提供了一种可重复且可审计的方法。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Guided Identification and In Vivo Validation of Compact Cis-Regulatory Elements for the Zebrafish Habenula.
papers.authors: Li, Zeran; Liu, Shanshan; Zhang, Quan; Zhang, Cuizhen; Peng, Gang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习模型（Enformer变体）跨物种预测并验证斑马鱼缰核的紧凑顺式调控元件，虽涉及染色质可及性建模，但核心是调控元件鉴定而非三维基因组/染色质空间架构建模，方法可迁移性有限。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Precise genetic access to the zebrafish habenula remains limited by a scarcity of compact, sequence-defined cis-regulatory elements (CREs). Here, we integrated developmental expression mapping, deep-learning predictions on long-range sequences, and in vivo reporter assays to identify compact regulatory sequences driving habenular expression. METHODS: Using a transgenic zebrafish line enriched for habenular reporter expression, we isolated GFP-positive cells from larval brains and profiled their transcriptomes via microarray. A subset of candidate genes enriched in this dataset was validated using whole-mount in situ hybridization across two developmental stages. This analysis identified genes with highly reproducible habenular expression, leading to the selection of the gng8 and ano2 loci for subsequent CRE characterization. We developed ZEN-former (Zebrafish EN-former), an Enformer-based sequence-to-function model trained on neuronal subclass chromatin accessibility profiles from the adult mouse brain. RESULTS: The model demonstrated strong correlation between predicted and experimentally measured signals across held-out genomic regions. To prioritize regulatory candidates, we integrated ZEN-former predictions with available zebrafish ATAC-seq data, RepeatMasker annotations, and gene models, identifying two ~600 bp intervals at each gene locus. These selected intervals were combined to generate ~1.2 kb reporter constructs for gng8 and ano2 loci, which were then evaluated using Tol2 transposon mediated transgenesis assays in zebrafish. In transiently injected larvae, both constructs successfully drove reporter expression in the habenular region. Furthermore, the resulting stable transgenic lines displayed highly specific and reproducible habenular expression. Quantitative confocal analysis showed mean habenular labeling completeness values of 84.5% and 96.2% for the gng8- and ano2-derived lines, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: Together, these findings provide a proof of concept that sequence features learned from mammalian chromatin accessibility datasets can effectively guide the prioritization of functional regulatory elements across species in zebrafish. The compact regulatory constructs and stable transgenic lines generated here offer robust genetic tools for investigating habenular circuitry.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标：对斑马鱼缰核的精准遗传操作仍受限于缺乏紧凑、序列定义的顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements, CREs）。在此，我们整合了发育表达图谱、长程序列的深度学习预测以及体内报告基因检测，以识别驱动缰核表达的紧凑调控序列。方法：利用富含缰核报告基因表达的转基因斑马鱼品系，我们从幼鱼脑中分离出GFP阳性细胞，并通过微阵列分析其转录组。该数据集中富集的一部分候选基因通过两个发育阶段的整封原位杂交进行了验证。此分析识别出具有高度可重复缰核表达的基因，从而选择gng8和ano2位点进行后续CRE表征。我们开发了ZEN-former（Zebrafish EN-former），一种基于Enformer的序列-功能模型，该模型在成年小鼠大脑的神经元亚类染色质可及性谱上进行了训练。结果：该模型在保留的基因组区域中，预测信号与实验测量信号之间表现出强相关性。为优先筛选调控候选元件，我们将ZEN-former预测与可用的斑马鱼ATAC-seq数据、RepeatMasker注释和基因模型相结合，在每个基因位点识别出两个约600 bp的区间。这些选定的区间被组合生成约1.2 kb的报告基因构建体，用于gng8和ano2位点，随后通过Tol2转座子介导的转基因检测在斑马鱼中进行了评估。在瞬时注射的幼鱼中，两种构建体均成功驱动了缰核区域的报告基因表达。此外，所得稳定转基因品系表现出高度特异且可重复的缰核表达。定量共聚焦分析显示，gng8和ano2衍生品系的平均缰核标记完整度分别为84.5%和96.2%。结论：综合来看，这些发现提供了概念验证，表明从哺乳动物染色质可及性数据集中学习到的序列特征可有效指导跨物种斑马鱼中功能性调控元件的优先筛选。此处生成的紧凑调控构建体和稳定转基因品系为研究缰核回路提供了稳健的遗传工具。

papers.title: Bridging BET bromodomain and immune checkpoint inhibitors through generative bioorganic frameworks for next-generation cancer immunotherapy.
papers.authors: Diab, Mohamed K; Yassen, Asmaa S A; Fahmy, Sherif Ashraf; Ashour, Heba F; Nafie, Mohamed S
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦BET溴结构域抑制剂与免疫检查点抑制剂联合的癌症免疫治疗，虽涉及染色质表观调控和生成式AI分子设计，但核心对象是药物组合而非三维基因组/染色质组织建模，且无染色质空间架构或互作的计算建模，仅边缘相关。
papers.abstract: Bromodomain and extraterminal domain (BET) proteins are epigenetic readers that couple chromatin acetylation to oncogenic and immune-regulatory gene transcription, making them attractive targets for combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in precision oncology. This review synthesizes current mechanistic, medicinal-chemistry, and translational evidence on BET-ICI combination strategies. We describe how BET blockade reshapes tumor chromatin architecture, suppresses PD-L1 expression, and enhances antigen presentation, thereby increasing tumor susceptibility to immune-mediated attack. We further summarize preclinical efficacy data for BET-ICI combinations, including systems-biology and agent-based computational models that predict substantially greater tumor-volume reduction with combination regimens relative to monotherapy in selected preclinical settings; however, early-phase clinical experience with these combinations remains limited and has not yet reproduced this magnitude of benefit. Beyond the mechanism, we review the medicinal chemistry underlying BET inhibitor design and the emerging landscape of BET-ICI hybrid and conjugate therapeutics, distinguishing combinations with direct experimental support from conceptual pairings that remain hypothesis-generating. Finally, we discuss how systems biology and generative, AI-guided molecular design may inform resistance-mechanism prediction, toxicity mitigation, and biomarker-guided, patient-specific compound selection. Collectively, this review outlines a framework for how the convergence of epigenetic reprogramming, immune modulation, and generative bioorganic chemistry could inform the rational design of next-generation BET-ICI combination therapeutics.
papers.abstract_zh: 溴结构域和末端外结构域（BET）蛋白是表观遗传阅读器，将染色质乙酰化与致癌及免疫调节基因转录耦合，使其成为精准肿瘤学中与免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）联合使用的有吸引力的靶点。本综述综合了关于BET-ICI联合策略的当前机制、药物化学和转化证据。我们描述了BET阻断如何重塑肿瘤染色质结构、抑制PD-L1表达并增强抗原呈递，从而增加肿瘤对免疫介导攻击的敏感性。我们进一步总结了BET-ICI联合治疗的临床前疗效数据，包括系统生物学和基于代理的计算模型，这些模型预测在选定的临床前环境中，联合方案相比单一疗法可实现显著更大的肿瘤体积缩减；然而，这些联合治疗的早期临床经验仍然有限，尚未重现这种程度的获益。在机制之外，我们回顾了BET抑制剂设计背后的药物化学以及BET-ICI杂交和偶联治疗的新兴格局，区分了具有直接实验支持的组合与仍处于假设生成阶段的概念性配对。最后，我们讨论了系统生物学和生成式、AI引导的分子设计如何为耐药机制预测、毒性缓解以及生物标志物引导的、患者特异性化合物选择提供信息。总体而言，本综述概述了一个框架，说明表观遗传重编程、免疫调节和生成式生物有机化学的融合如何为下一代BET-ICI联合治疗药物的合理设计提供信息。

papers.title: A Brownian dynamics study of liquid-liquid phase separation in multiscale chromatin networks.
papers.authors: Beaules, Lea; Mine-Hattab, Judith; Illien, Pierre; Dahirel, Vincent
papers.journal: The European physical journal. E, Soft matter
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用布朗动力学模拟研究染色质纤维多尺度网络如何调控液-液相分离凝聚体的形态与空间组织，直接涉及染色质空间架构与凝聚体形成的计算建模，对三维基因组架构与核内调控的机理研究有重要启发。
papers.abstract: In living cells, proteins involved in specialized biochemical functions are often spatially organized within biomolecular condensates. Increasing evidence suggests that some of these condensates, including DNA repair condensates, emerge through liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). In the nucleus, however, condensates form within a highly heterogeneous environment composed of chromatin fibers, RNA, and additional protein scaffolds such as PAR chains, all of which may interact with phase-separating proteins. Moreover, condensate formation is frequently associated with specific chromatin conformations; for instance, loop extrusion has been proposed as a mechanism promoting DNA repair condensates. Here, we investigate how the surrounding fibrous environment controls the morphology and spatial organization of phase-separated condensates. Using Brownian dynamics simulations of minimal models combining Lennard-Jones particles with fixed fibrous substrates, we examine the respective roles of local fiber geometry and large-scale network organization, reflecting the multiscale architecture of chromatin. We show that protein-fiber interactions strongly influence droplet positioning relative to the substrate, in a manner analogous to wetting transitions in soft condensed matter systems. Both local geometric constraints and global network organization markedly affect droplet size, morphology, and multiplicity. In addition, large-scale asymmetries in fiber organization can induce robust spatial localization of the dense phase. Our results thus highlight how multiscale structural heterogeneity of the nuclear environment can regulate the emergence and organization of biomolecular condensates.
papers.abstract_zh: 在活细胞中，参与特定生化功能的蛋白质通常会在生物分子凝聚体（biomolecular condensates）内进行空间组织。越来越多的证据表明，其中一些凝聚体，包括DNA修复凝聚体，是通过液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation, LLPS）形成的。然而，在细胞核中，凝聚体是在由染色质纤维、RNA以及诸如PAR链等额外蛋白质支架组成的高度异质环境中形成的，所有这些都可能与相分离蛋白相互作用。此外，凝聚体的形成通常与特定的染色质构象相关；例如，环挤压（loop extrusion）已被提出作为促进DNA修复凝聚体形成的机制。在此，我们研究了周围纤维环境如何控制相分离凝聚体的形态和空间组织。通过结合Lennard-Jones粒子与固定纤维底物的最小模型的布朗动力学模拟，我们考察了局部纤维几何结构和大规模网络组织的各自作用，这反映了染色质的多尺度架构。我们表明，蛋白质-纤维相互作用强烈影响液滴相对于底物的定位，其方式类似于软凝聚态物质系统中的润湿转变。局部几何约束和全局网络组织均显著影响液滴的大小、形态和多重性。此外，纤维组织中的大规模不对称性可诱导致密相的稳健空间定位。因此，我们的结果突显了核环境的多尺度结构异质性如何调节生物分子凝聚体的形成和组织。

papers.title: ssJSD: A Fusion of Sparsity and Spatial Information for HiC Single-Cell Clustering.
papers.authors: Lee, Sang Wan; Lin, Shili
papers.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出融合稀疏性与空间信息的ssJSD框架用于scHiC单细胞聚类，虽以三维基因组为对象并涉及空间互作模式，但核心是聚类方法而非染色质三维架构建模，且未采用AI或分子模拟方法。
papers.abstract: Single-cell high-throughput chromatin conformation capture (scHiC) enables profiling three-dimensional genome architecture at cellular resolution, providing insights into cell-to-cell variability and cellular functions. Recent frameworks utilize spatial interaction patterns to derive dissimilarity measures for downstream tasks such as cell clustering. However, the inherent sparsity and ultra-high dimensionality of scHiC contact matrices pose significant challenges. A central hurdle is that existing measures typically treat all zeros without distinction, failing to differentiate biologically meaningful structural zeros (SZs) from technical dropouts. Here, we introduce ssJSD (spatial and sparsity informed Jensen-Shannon Divergence), a computational framework designed to explicitly account for scHiC-specific sparsity patterns. By integrating band-wise contact frequency profiles with SZ-induced sparsity matrices, ssJSD leverages both spatial interaction patterns and biological absence of contacts. We adopted two complementary integration strategies: an early fusion approach that concatenates information into a single representation, and a late fusion approach that integrates JSD-based dissimilarities through diverse averaging methods. Through simulations and applications to human cell lines and prefrontal cortex data, we demonstrate that ssJSD improves clustering accuracy and effectively distinguishes cell types. Our study indicates that integrating SZ patterns is important for accurately quantifying cell-to-cell variability in 3D genomics.
papers.abstract_zh: 单细胞高通量染色质构象捕获（scHiC）技术能够在细胞分辨率下分析三维基因组结构，为揭示细胞间变异及细胞功能提供见解。近期框架利用空间相互作用模式来推导相异性度量，用于细胞聚类等下游任务。然而，scHiC接触矩阵固有的稀疏性和超高维性带来了显著挑战。一个核心障碍在于，现有度量通常不加区分地处理所有零值，未能区分具有生物学意义的结构零（SZs）与技术性缺失。在此，我们引入ssJSD（空间及稀疏性感知的Jensen-Shannon散度），这是一个计算框架，旨在明确考虑scHiC特有的稀疏模式。通过将带状接触频率谱与SZ诱导的稀疏矩阵相结合，ssJSD同时利用空间相互作用模式和生物学上的接触缺失。我们采用了两种互补的整合策略：一种早期融合方法，将信息拼接为单一表示；以及一种晚期融合方法，通过多种平均方式整合基于JSD的相异性度量。通过模拟实验及对人类细胞系和前额叶皮层数据的应用，我们证明ssJSD提高了聚类准确性，并能有效区分细胞类型。我们的研究表明，整合SZ模式对于准确量化3D基因组学中的细胞间变异至关重要。

papers.title: Temporal regulation of a spatial patterning factor in Drosophila neurogenesis.
papers.authors: Coyne, Rose; Kamulegeya, Fahad; Lake, Cathleen; Rajesh, Raghuvanshi; Treese, McKenzie; Chen, Yen-Chung; Troutwine, Benjamin; Zeitlinger, Julia; Ozel, Mehmet Neset
papers.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究果蝇视叶神经发生中空间与时间模式因子如何通过模块化增强子调控同一选择因子，虽涉及染色质可及性深度学习模型，但核心是神经发育调控而非三维基因组/染色质组织建模，方法可迁移性有限。
papers.abstract: A central question in neurobiology is how the transient programs that pattern neural progenitors are translated into the enormous, stable diversity of neuronal types. Spatial and temporal cues act only briefly, yet each neuron's identity is defined and maintained for life by terminal selector transcription factors (TFs). How a neuron's developmental origin is read out into a particular selector code remains poorly understood. Some current models propose that spatial and temporal origins are inherited independently through separate selectors. We show instead that, in the Drosophila optic lobe, the same selector can be activated by different patterning axes through physically distinct enhancers, even within the same lineage. Visual system homeobox (Vsx1) spatially patterns a central neuroepithelial domain and later acts as a terminal selector in dozens of neuronal types, most originating exclusively from that domain. However, in Dm2 neurons that are produced from every domain, it is regulated not by neuroepithelial Vsx1 but by the neuroblast temporal TF BarH1, through an enhancer distinct from its domain-specific ones. Combining in vivo reporters with sequence-to-accessibility deep-learning models, we identify and disrupt the key binding sites in this enhancer, impairing its Dm2-specific activity. Reciprocally, the temporal TF Homeobrain (Hbn) acts as a terminal selector in the related neuron Mi21 independently of its neuroblast temporal window: its expression in these late-born neurons is instead placed under dorsoventral spatial control. Patterning inputs therefore need not be partitioned across separate selectors but converge combinatorially on the modular enhancers of shared ones, revealing a cis-regulatory logic that re-encodes this limited set of inputs into vast neuronal diversity.
papers.abstract_zh: 神经生物学中的一个核心问题是，塑造神经祖细胞的瞬时程序如何被转化为神经元类型的巨大而稳定的多样性。空间和时间线索仅短暂作用，然而每个神经元的身份却由末端选择器转录因子（TFs）定义并终生维持。神经元的发育起源如何被解读为特定的选择器编码，仍知之甚少。一些当前模型提出，空间和时间起源通过独立的选择器分别继承。我们反而表明，在果蝇视叶中，同一选择器可以通过物理上不同的增强子被不同模式轴激活，即使在同一谱系内也是如此。视觉系统同源盒（Vsx1）在空间上模式化一个中央神经上皮域，并随后在数十种神经元类型中作为末端选择器发挥作用，其中大多数仅起源于该域。然而，在从每个域产生的Dm2神经元中，它并非由神经上皮Vsx1调控，而是由神经母细胞时间转录因子BarH1通过一个与其域特异性增强子不同的增强子调控。结合体内报告基因与序列到可及性深度学习模型，我们识别并破坏了该增强子中的关键结合位点，损害了其Dm2特异性活性。相反，时间转录因子Homeobrain（Hbn）在相关神经元Mi21中作为末端选择器发挥作用，独立于其神经母细胞时间窗口：其在这些晚期出生神经元中的表达反而被置于背腹空间控制之下。因此，模式化输入不必在独立选择器之间分配，而是组合性地汇聚在共享选择器的模块化增强子上，揭示了一种顺式调控逻辑，将这一有限输入集重新编码为巨大的神经元多样性。

papers.title: Machine learning reveals sequence and genomic context features underlying Alu -specific effects on genome folding.
papers.authors: Zhang, Shu; Pollard, Katherine S
papers.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习对约110万个Alu元件进行全基因组模拟删除筛选，预测其对局部染色质折叠的影响，并揭示Alu序列特征与基因组背景如何调控TAD边界、CTCF介导的染色质环和区室结构，直接聚焦三维基因组架构的AI建模，与课题高度契合。
papers.abstract: The Alu transposable element is among the most abundant classes of mobile DNA in the human genome, and has been linked to gene regulation and chromatin organization. Yet how individual Alu insertions influence nearby chromatin interactions remains poorly understood. To investigate this, we used deep learning to perform a genome-wide in silico deletion screen of ~1.1 million Alus , predicting each element's importance to local genome folding. We identified a subset of high-scoring Alus that span multiple Alu subfamilies and are enriched in loci that are fast-evolving and gene-dense, especially loci encoding genes that are actively transcribed and/or related to Alu biology. We further found that polymorphic Alus preferentially occur in regions tolerant of sequence variation but predicted to be resistant to changes in chromatin structure. Targeted in silico mutagenesis showed that the importance of individual Alus to local chromatin interactions depends on both intrinsic Alu sequence properties and genomic context. Finally, we identified Alu sequences predicted to alter CTCF-mediated boundary strength and, in some cases, to promote the formation of new loops and boundaries. Together, these results position Alus as key modulators of genome architecture, while underscoring that the fate of a new Alu depends on where it inserts and how it interacts with other determinants of chromatin state and structure.
papers.abstract_zh: Alu转座元件是人类基因组中最丰富的移动DNA类别之一，并与基因调控和染色质组织相关联。然而，单个Alu插入如何影响邻近染色质相互作用仍知之甚少。为探究此问题，我们利用深度学习对约110万个Alu进行了全基因组范围内的计算机模拟删除筛选，预测每个元件对局部基因组折叠的重要性。我们识别出一组高评分的Alu，这些Alu跨越多个Alu亚家族，并在快速进化和基因密集的位点中富集，尤其是编码活跃转录和/或与Alu生物学相关基因的位点。我们进一步发现，多态性Alu优先出现在对序列变异耐受但预测对染色质结构变化具有抵抗性的区域。靶向计算机模拟诱变显示，单个Alu对局部染色质相互作用的重要性既取决于Alu内在序列特性，也取决于基因组背景。最后，我们识别出预测能改变CTCF介导边界强度，并在某些情况下促进新环和边界形成的Alu序列。综合来看，这些结果将Alu定位为基因组架构的关键调节因子，同时强调新Alu的命运取决于其插入位置及其与其他染色质状态和结构决定因素的相互作用方式。

papers.title: Designing gene expression with MPRA and AI: A new paradigm for synthetic and therapeutic regulation.
papers.authors: Zhang, Xue; Huang, Xiao-Yan; Wang, Hui-Yu; Bai, Feng-Wu; Li, Kai; Hu, Shen S
papers.one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦MPRA与AI驱动的顺式调控元件设计，虽涉及染色质水平调控元件，但未建模三维基因组/染色质空间组织，方法上以深度学习预测为主，与课题部分相关。
papers.abstract: Precise and scalable control of gene expression across biological contexts remains a fundamental challenge in synthetic biology and therapeutic development, and massively parallel reporter assays (MPRAs) have emerged as a transformative platform for systematically interrogating cis-regulatory elements (CREs) and enabling high-throughput and quantitative dissection of sequence-dependent transcriptional activity to address this challenge. Beyond their original role in empirical characterization, the convergence of barcoded MPRA technologies with deep learning-based modeling has substantially expanded their impact, facilitating predictive inference and the de novo design of synthetic regulatory elements with programmable behavior. In this review, we synthesize recent advances in barcoded MPRA platforms and AI-driven modeling frameworks for the rational engineering of CREs with tunable transcriptional strength and specificity. We further highlight cutting-edge applications in microbial synthetic biology, mRNA therapeutics, and cell-specific gene regulation, emphasizing the role of barcoded MPRA in supporting data-efficient and cross-context generalizable design. Finally, we discuss current technical and conceptual limitations and future directions toward safe, programmable, and clinically relevant regulatory control systems, outlining a roadmap for next-generation cis-regulatory engineering and gene therapies.
papers.abstract_zh: 在不同生物学背景下实现基因表达的精确且可扩展控制，仍是合成生物学与治疗开发中的根本性挑战，而大规模平行报告分析（MPRAs）已成为系统性探究顺式调控元件（CREs）并实现序列依赖性转录活性的高通量、定量解析的变革性平台，以应对这一挑战。超越其最初在经验表征中的角色，条形码化MPRA技术与基于深度学习的建模的融合显著扩展了其影响力，促进了预测性推断及具有可编程行为的合成调控元件的从头设计。在本综述中，我们综合了条形码化MPRA平台和AI驱动建模框架在合理工程化具有可调转录强度与特异性的CREs方面的最新进展。我们进一步强调了在微生物合成生物学、mRNA疗法及细胞特异性基因调控中的前沿应用，着重指出条形码化MPRA在支持数据高效且跨情境可泛化设计中的作用。最后，我们讨论了当前技术与概念上的局限性，以及面向安全、可编程且临床相关的调控控制系统的未来方向，为下一代顺式调控工程与基因治疗勾勒出路线图。

papers.title: Deep genomic models of allele-specific measurements.
papers.authors: Tu, Xinming; Sasse, Alexander; Chowdhary, Kaitavjeet; Spiro, Anna; Yang, Liang; Chikina, Maria; Benoist, Christophe; Mostafavi, Sara
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出DeepAllele深度学习模型，利用等位基因特异性测序数据预测顺式调控差异，虽涉及染色质水平调控但未直接建模三维基因组空间架构，方法可迁移至染色质调控特征建模。
papers.abstract: Allele-specific quantification of sequencing data allows for a systematic investigation of how DNA sequence variations influence cis gene regulation. Current methods for analyzing allele-specific measurements for causal analysis rely on statistical associations between genetic variation across individuals and allelic imbalance. Instead, we propose DeepAllele, a novel deep learning sequence-to-function model using paired allele-specific input, designed to learn sequence features that predict subtle changes in gene regulation between alleles. Our approach is suited for datasets with unambiguous phasing, such as F1 hybrids and other controlled genetic crosses, or long-read sequencing technologies used in Fiber-seq, in which reads can be assigned to complete allele sequences. We apply our framework to allele-specific measurements in immune cells from F1 hybrid mice, and show that the model's additionally learned cis-regulatory grammar aligns with known biological mechanisms across a significantly larger number of genomic regions compared to baseline models. In summary, our work presents a computational framework to leverage genetic variation to uncover functionally-relevant regulatory motifs, enhancing discovery in genomics.
papers.abstract_zh: 对测序数据进行等位基因特异性定量分析，能够系统探究DNA序列变异如何影响顺式基因调控。当前用于因果分析的等位基因特异性测量方法，依赖于个体间遗传变异与等位基因不平衡之间的统计关联。相反，我们提出DeepAllele，一种新颖的深度学习序列到功能模型，采用配对等位基因特异性输入，旨在学习预测等位基因间基因调控细微变化的序列特征。我们的方法适用于具有明确单倍型分型的数据集，如F1杂交及其他受控遗传杂交，或Fiber-seq中使用的长读长测序技术，其中读段可分配给完整的等位基因序列。我们将此框架应用于F1杂交小鼠免疫细胞的等位基因特异性测量，并展示该模型额外学习的顺式调控语法，在显著更多的基因组区域上与已知生物学机制对齐，优于基线模型。总之，我们的工作提供了一个计算框架，利用遗传变异揭示功能相关的调控基序，增强基因组学中的发现能力。

papers.title: Prediction of pH-sensing histidine residues in human cells
papers.authors: Sallah S; Warwicker J
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文预测人类蛋白质组中pH感应组氨酸残基，虽涉及转录调控和染色质相关复合物（如cohesin），但核心是氨基酸序列与结构分析，无三维基因组/染色质组织建模，也无AI或分子模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
papers.abstract: Changes in pH play an important role in human physiology and cell behaviours, evidenced by studies of tissues and gene expression, and the biophysics of individual systems. Bridging between these scales to establish pH-sensing networks has only been partially explored. Here, amino acid conservation and structural context, and benchmarking with known pH-sensors, were used to predict histidine residues within the human proteome that could modulate pH-dependence. Proteins containing these histidines are enriched in many categories, most notably nucleic acid-binding and transcriptional regulation. DNA phosphate backbone interactions are proposed to play a major role in modulating some pH-sensors. Transcription factors with potential pH-sensors and the largest number of documented target genes are highlighted, including those involved in circadian and developmental processes. Certain CDK-cyclin pairs also feature, along with components of SWI/SNF and cohesin complexes. Focussing on histidines, including those that are solvent accessible in AlphaFold protomer models, this study generates benchmarked predictions for possible pH-sensors in the human proteome.
papers.abstract_zh: pH变化在人体生理和细胞行为中扮演重要角色，这一点已通过组织和基因表达研究以及单个系统的生物物理学得到证实。然而，在这些尺度之间建立pH感应网络的桥梁仅被部分探索。本研究利用氨基酸保守性和结构背景，并与已知pH传感器进行基准测试，预测人类蛋白质组中可能调节pH依赖性的组氨酸残基。含有这些组氨酸的蛋白质在多个类别中富集，尤其是核酸结合和转录调控。DNA磷酸骨架相互作用被认为在调节某些pH传感器中发挥重要作用。具有潜在pH传感器且记录靶基因数量最多的转录因子被突出显示，包括参与昼夜节律和发育过程的那些。某些CDK-周期蛋白对也出现在其中，以及SWI/SNF和黏连蛋白复合物的组分。聚焦于组氨酸，包括AlphaFold原聚体模型中溶剂可及的组氨酸，本研究为人类蛋白质组中可能的pH传感器生成了基准预测。

papers.title: Transcriptomic and Machine-Learning Prioritization of OCEL1 in Low Bone Mineral Density With Multivariable cis-MR
papers.authors: Yao J; Zhong Q
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用转录组和机器学习优先筛选低骨密度相关基因OCEL1并结合顺式孟德尔随机化分析，对象为骨密度而非染色质三维组织，且无染色质空间架构建模或AI/分子模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract:
Introduction

Low bone mineral density (BMD) is associated with altered bone remodeling and osteoimmune regulation. We aimed to prioritize transcript-level signals supported across human expression cohorts and evaluate their attribution within local cis-regulatory architecture.

Materials and Methods

Nominal differential-expression signals from GSE56815 were restricted with a predefined 25-term MSigDB thematic library. Features measurable in GSE56815 and GSE2208 underwent linear SVM ranking, LASSO, and XGBoost selection, followed by cross-cohort transcriptomic assessment. OCEL1 was examined in a four-exposure locus-aware CisMRBEEX model with NR2F6, MRPL34, BABAM1, eQTLGen cis-eQTLs, heel eBMD GWAS statistics, and UKBB337K LD.

Results

The expression screen identified 2,568 genes at nominal P<0.05; thematic restriction retained 190 candidates and 107 common features entered machine learning. Linear SVM, LASSO, and XGBoost retained 24, 18, and 9 genes and converged on CPNE1, EZR, and OCEL1. Only OCEL1 showed concordant expression direction with P<0.05 in both cohorts. In the primary 268-variant four-exposure model, OCEL1 was positively associated with heel eBMD (β=0.010293, SE=0.004107, 95% CI 0.002244-0.018342, P=0.01220, PIP=0.4001; conditional coefficient on the standardized analysis scale); BABAM1 retained an oppositely directed component. The no-palindromic reconstruction remained positive with wider uncertainty (β=0.007652, P=0.06739).

Conclusion

Convergent transcriptomic evidence prioritized OCEL1, whose conditional genetic-expression component was positively associated with heel eBMD after local shared cis regulation was modeled.
papers.abstract_zh:
引言

低骨密度（BMD）与骨重塑和骨免疫调节的改变相关。我们旨在优先考虑跨人类表达队列支持的转录本水平信号，并评估其在局部顺式调控架构中的归因。

材料与方法

来自GSE56815的名义差异表达信号通过预定义的25项MSigDB主题库进行限制。在GSE56815和GSE2208中可测量的特征经过线性SVM排序、LASSO和XGBoost选择，随后进行跨队列转录组评估。OCEL1在四暴露位点感知CisMRBEEX模型中检验，该模型包含NR2F6、MRPL34、BABAM1、eQTLGen顺式eQTL、跟骨eBMD GWAS统计数据和UKBB337K LD。

结果

表达筛选在名义P<0.05下识别出2,568个基因；主题限制保留了190个候选基因，107个共同特征进入机器学习。线性SVM、LASSO和XGBoost分别保留了24、18和9个基因，并收敛于CPNE1、EZR和OCEL1。仅OCEL1在两个队列中显示一致的表达方向且P<0.05。在主要的268变异四暴露模型中，OCEL1与跟骨eBMD正相关（β=0.010293，SE=0.004107，95% CI 0.002244-0.018342，P=0.01220，PIP=0.4001；标准化分析尺度上的条件系数）；BABAM1保留了方向相反的成分。无回文重建仍为正相关，但不确定性更大（β=0.007652，P=0.06739）。

结论

收敛的转录组证据优先考虑OCEL1，其条件遗传表达成分在局部共享顺式调控建模后与跟骨eBMD正相关。

papers.title: Machine learning reveals sequence and genomic context features underlying Alu -specific effects on genome folding
papers.authors: Zhang S; Pollard KS
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习对约110万个Alu元件进行全基因组模拟删除筛选，预测其对局部染色质折叠的影响，并揭示Alu序列特征与基因组背景如何调控TAD边界、染色质环等三维基因组结构，直接契合本课题的染色质空间架构建模与AI方法。
papers.abstract: The Alu transposable element is among the most abundant classes of mobile DNA in the human genome, and has been linked to gene regulation and chromatin organization. Yet how individual Alu insertions influence nearby chromatin interactions remains poorly understood. To investigate this, we used deep learning to perform a genome-wide in silico deletion screen of ~1.1 million Alus , predicting each element's importance to local genome folding. We identified a subset of high-scoring Alus that span multiple Alu subfamilies and are enriched in loci that are fast-evolving and gene-dense, especially loci encoding genes that are actively transcribed and/or related to Alu biology. We further found that polymorphic Alus preferentially occur in regions tolerant of sequence variation but predicted to be resistant to changes in chromatin structure. Targeted in silico mutagenesis showed that the importance of individual Alus to local chromatin interactions depends on both intrinsic Alu sequence properties and genomic context. Finally, we identified Alu sequences predicted to alter CTCF-mediated boundary strength and, in some cases, to promote the formation of new loops and boundaries. Together, these results position Alus as key modulators of genome architecture, while underscoring that the fate of a new Alu depends on where it inserts and how it interacts with other determinants of chromatin state and structure.
papers.abstract_zh: Alu转座元件是人类基因组中最丰富的移动DNA类别之一，与基因调控和染色质组织相关联。然而，单个Alu插入如何影响邻近染色质相互作用仍知之甚少。为探究此问题，我们利用深度学习对约110万个Alu进行了全基因组范围内的计算机模拟删除筛选，预测每个元件对局部基因组折叠的重要性。我们识别出一组高评分的Alu，这些Alu跨越多个Alu亚家族，并在快速进化和基因密集的位点中富集，尤其是编码活跃转录和/或与Alu生物学相关基因的位点。我们进一步发现，多态性Alu优先出现在对序列变异耐受但预测对染色质结构变化具有抵抗性的区域。靶向计算机模拟诱变显示，单个Alu对局部染色质相互作用的重要性既取决于Alu内在序列特性，也取决于基因组背景。最后，我们识别出预测能改变CTCF介导边界强度，并在某些情况下促进新环和边界形成的Alu序列。综合来看，这些结果将Alu定位为基因组架构的关键调节因子，同时强调新Alu的命运取决于其插入位置及其与其他染色质状态和结构决定因素的相互作用方式。

papers.title: Endogenous Nuclear Desmin Associates with the Nuclear Envelope in Human Skeletal Muscle Cells
papers.authors: Duz N; Avci A; Sahin S; Kastelic M; Ozcan S; Dincer P
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究肌肉细胞中核内desmin与核纤层蛋白的互作及核架构组织，虽涉及核架构和计算结构建模，但对象非染色质/三维基因组，且方法为蛋白对接而非染色质建模，启发有限。
papers.abstract: Desmin is the major intermediate filament protein of muscle, yet its potential nuclear functions remain poorly understood. Here, we investigated the nuclear localization and organization of endogenous desmin in human skeletal muscle cells using quantitative confocal microscopy, biochemical fractionation, targeted MRM/SRM proteomics, and computational structural modeling. Desmin localized to the nuclear compartment and exhibited significantly stronger colocalization with emerin and lamin A/C than with lamin B1. Nuclear fractionation and targeted proteomics independently confirmed endogenous nuclear desmin, while protein-protein docking predicted structurally plausible interactions with all three nuclear envelope proteins, supporting a context-dependent nuclear interaction network. Together, these findings identify the nuclear envelope as a functional platform for desmin and suggest that nuclear desmin contributes to nucleo-cytoskeletal communication and the organization of mechanically responsive nuclear architecture during myogenesis. This work expands the current understanding of desmin biology and provides a framework for investigating its role in desmin-related muscle disease.
papers.abstract_zh: Desmin是肌肉中主要的中间丝蛋白，但其潜在的核功能仍知之甚少。在此，我们利用定量共聚焦显微镜、生化分级分离、靶向MRM/SRM蛋白质组学和计算结构建模，研究了人骨骼肌细胞内源性desmin的核定位和组织。Desmin定位于核区室，并与emerin和lamin A/C的共定位显著强于与lamin B1的共定位。核分级分离和靶向蛋白质组学独立确认了内源性核desmin的存在，而蛋白质-蛋白质对接预测了其与所有三种核膜蛋白的结构上合理的相互作用，支持一种情境依赖的核相互作用网络。综合来看，这些发现将核膜确定为desmin的功能平台，并提示核desmin在肌生成过程中有助于核-细胞骨架通信和机械响应性核架构的组织。这项工作扩展了当前对desmin生物学的理解，并为研究其在desmin相关肌肉疾病中的作用提供了框架。

papers.title: CoxFormer enables spatial omics inference with multimodal generative modeling.
papers.authors: Yang, Yiyang; Liao, Xu; Zhang, Haoyu; Wu, Yida; Jiao, Yuling; Sun, Xiaobo; Wang, Yao; Yu, Tianshu; Liu, Jin
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用多模态生成模型推断空间组学中未测基因表达，虽涉及染色质可及性预测，但核心是基因表达推断而非染色质三维组织建模，且无AI/分子模拟方法用于染色质空间架构，与本课题关联较弱。
papers.abstract: Gene co-expression maps transcriptome-wide gene-gene relationships, yet high-quality estimates cover less than half the genome. Meanwhile, spatial omics either profiles restricted in situ panels or lacks cellular resolution. Extending co-expression transcriptome-wide could overcome these limitations by inferring unassayed gene expression at subcellular resolution. Here we show that CoxFormer integrates literature-derived gene knowledge with co-expression networks from bulk tissues and large-scale single-cell atlases to learn 512-dimensional representations for 32,016 human genes. These embeddings capture functional gene relationships and serve as a generative prior for spatial inference across platforms and modalities. Without requiring a matched single-cell RNA-sequencing reference, CoxFormer supports four applications beyond measured genes: histology-based expression imputation, gene activity prediction from chromatin accessibility, subcellular super-resolution inference, and pathological region detection. Together, CoxFormer extends gene embedding from gene- and cell-level tasks to whole-transcriptome spatial inference, providing a unified framework for biological analysis beyond the limited gene coverage of current spatial omics technologies.
papers.abstract_zh: 基因共表达描绘了全转录组范围内的基因-基因关系，然而高质量的估计仅覆盖了不到一半的基因组。与此同时，空间组学要么局限于检测受限的原位基因面板，要么缺乏细胞分辨率。将共表达扩展到全转录组范围，可以通过在亚细胞分辨率下推断未检测基因的表达来克服这些限制。在此，我们展示了CoxFormer整合了文献来源的基因知识与来自批量组织和大型单细胞图谱的共表达网络，为32,016个人类基因学习512维表示。这些嵌入捕获了功能性基因关系，并作为跨平台和模态的空间推断的生成性先验。无需匹配的单细胞RNA测序参考，CoxFormer支持超出已测量基因的四种应用：基于组织学的表达插补、从染色质可及性预测基因活性、亚细胞超分辨率推断以及病理区域检测。综上，CoxFormer将基因嵌入从基因和细胞层面的任务扩展到全转录组空间推断，为超越当前空间组学技术有限基因覆盖范围的生物学分析提供了一个统一框架。

papers.title: GenoME: a MoE-based generative model for individualized, multimodal prediction and perturbation of genomic profiles.
papers.authors: Wei, Jiachen; Xue, Yue; Chai, Hao; Gao, Yi Qin
papers.one_liner_zh: GenoME 是基于MoE的生成模型，整合DNA序列与ATAC-seq预测表观、转录及染色质三维构象等多模态基因组谱，并支持扰动模拟与增强子-启动子互作识别，与三维基因组调控建模高度相关。
papers.abstract: The non-coding genome operates through a complex, multiscale regulatory system where regulated gene expressions are closely associated with cell-type-specific histone modifications, transcription factor binding, and 3D conformation. Developing computational models that can integrate these patterns to predict and interpret the regulatory system remains challenging. Here, we present GenoME, a Mixture of Experts (MoE)-based generative model that uses DNA sequence and cell-type-specific ATAC-seq signals to predict a unified genomic profiles encompassing epigenomics, transcriptomics, and chromatin architecture at base-pair to kilobase resolutions. GenoME enables multiscale predictions for held-out genomic regions and, critically, generalizes to predict the full regulatory landscape of unseen or individualized cell types from a single ATAC-seq input.
